set.body: Observed during eco-u3-topology full qualification at source1cb288d5f: mvpaFitJS compilation lost locus4s.provenance products even though its classpath was correct; stale Zinc said No changes.33 provider analysis files in owned base dc58d8731036fb76 had absent product directories. Sources remained pinned/clean. Template788c6bdac97cca30 contains109 absolute dc58 base references in provenanceJS inc_compile.bin; seeded secondary base613c2f1216058878 analysis now contains109 secondary references and1 historical primary reference. tools/build/sbt-warm clone_tree copies these absolute analysis paths unchanged. Likely mechanism: a newly seeded build invalidates prior products in its template source base. Do not claim causal reproduction yet. Evidence: common Git verification/topology-cutover-20261019/template-analysis-cross-paths.json and missing-products-repair/receipt.json, plus batch31 adverse log. Current recovery preserves/invalidates orphaned records in place under exclusive own-base lock and rebuilds; no source/output directory deleted. Fix template seeding so new worktrees cannot mutate prior bases; verify with a tiny isolated two-base reproducer, retaining first-base output hashes across the second build. Do not touch active bases, user caches or other sessions. Keep this tooling fix outside the topology source/review diff.
set.title: Make sbt-warm template analysis safe across worktree bases
